ciUse: Since 2026-11-05 scripts/ci/research-python.sh installs requirements-numeric-linux-py312.lock with --require-hashes in a temporary venv and runs tests/test_quant_replay_event_study.py with VERTEX_REQUIRE_NUMERIC=1 (card vertex-research-py-suite-rot). Test use only; no runtime qualification. The approval record below is kept as written.

target.platform_condition: glibc >= 2.27; host libc and installer tag acceptance were not probed
glibc >= 2.27; host libc and installer tag acceptance were not probed

license.expression: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

license.notice_scope: Metadata says this binary distribution can also bundle these components; actual archive members were not inspected.
license.release_vs_target_metadata_difference: Release JSON license text references scipy/.dylibs paths and libgcc as well as libgfortran. The selected Linux wheel sidecar references scipy.libs and lists libgfortran for GCC runtime. Preserve this distinction; use selected-wheel metadata for its declared notices, not a blanket BSD-only artifact characterization.

compatibility_reasoning: CPython 3.12.11 satisfies NumPy >=3.11 and SciPy >=3.12; both selected wheels are tagged cp312-cp312.
NumPy 2.4.6 satisfies SciPy's exact observed runtime constraint: >=2.0.0 and <2.8.
Both selected wheels provide x86_64 manylinux_2_27 and manylinux_2_28 tags. Linux/x86_64 alone does not prove libc compatibility; glibc >=2.27 remains a stated condition.
Both package versions are stable releases and both release and selected-file yanked flags are false.
No extras are selected. SciPy's test/doc/dev requirements are excluded; NumPy has null Requires-Dist in version JSON and no Requires-Dist headers in selected-wheel core metadata.

Python distribution runtime closure is exactly NumPy and SciPy. Native shared libraries and operating-system dependencies are not additional pip Requires-Dist entries, and their actual runtime closure was not inspected.

identity_separation.existing_source: Gamma lock establishes its NumPy choice and expected artifact URL/hash/size, not an installed environment or downloaded artifact.
identity_separation.official_release: PyPI version JSON supplies release requirements, license metadata, file hashes, sizes, upload times and yanked flags.
identity_separation.selected_artifact_metadata: Only plain core-metadata sidecars ending .whl.metadata were fetched from files.pythonhosted.org; no .whl or source-archive content was fetched.
identity_separation.artifact_integrity: Wheel SHA256 values are observed PyPI metadata values, not hashes independently calculated over downloaded wheel bytes.
identity_separation.scipy_origin: SciPy is a new official-artifact proposal. It must not be attributed to Gamma's existing lock.

unavailable_or_mismatched_metadata: SciPy 1.18.1 license_expression and license_files are null in PyPI version JSON; selected core metadata also has no License-Expression or License-File headers. Legacy license text and classifier evidence are available.
SciPy release JSON and exact Linux wheel metadata have different bundled-library path notices, as recorded above.
No NumPy pin or artifact identity mismatch was observed; no alternative NumPy version is proposed.
Full license-file contents, actual bundled artifact inventory, host libc, installed environment and runtime behavior remain outside this investigation.
